# Sennel

> Terminal KeePass (KDBX4) password manager. Bare `sennel` is an interactive TUI that needs a TTY.
> Agents should use the non-interactive subcommands: `get`, `gen`, `audit`, `import`, `export`,
> `convert`, `--list` and `--check`. Pass `--stdout` to get a value back, and send the master password as the
> first line of stdin.

## For agents

- [CLI reference for AI agents](docs/agents.md): every scriptable command, with flags, output
  formats, exit codes and recipes. Start here.

## Docs

- [sennel get](docs/get.md): fetch one field of one entry
- [Generating passwords](docs/generate.md): `sennel gen`, complex, passphrase and pin
- [Auditing](docs/audit.md): `sennel audit` and the `--pwned` breach check
- [Importing](docs/import.md): CSV from KeePassXC, Bitwarden or 1Password
- [Exporting](docs/export.md): `sennel export`, CSV or JSON, plaintext
- [Older KDBX files](docs/kdbx3.md): `sennel convert`
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): config file keys and defaults
- [Finding entries](docs/search.md): fuzzy search, tags, expiry and sort order
- [One-time codes](docs/one-time-codes.md): adding TOTP seeds and copying codes
- [Vaults](docs/vaults.md): several vaults, merging, backups, undo and history
- [Security](docs/security.md): what is wiped, when, and why

## Optional

- [Keys](docs/keys.md): the TUI key map, for tasks the CLI cannot do (add, edit, delete, re-key)
- [README](README.md)
